SELECT FROM requirement r WHERE r.project_id = #{projectId} AND r.deleted = 0 ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO requirement ( requirement_no, project_id, created_by, initiative_id, version_id, title, raw_text, acceptance_text, clarification_text, status, pool_status, source, review_comment, reviewed_by, reviewed_at, clarification_questions, assumptions, task_drafts, planned_at, clarified_at, deleted, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{requirementNo}, #{projectId}, #{createdBy}, #{initiativeId}, #{versionId}, #{title}, #{rawText}, #{acceptanceText}, #{clarificationText}, #{status}, #{poolStatus}, #{source}, #{reviewComment}, #{reviewedBy}, #{reviewedAt}, #{clarificationQuestions}, #{assumptions}, #{taskDrafts}, #{plannedAt}, #{clarifiedAt}, 0, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE requirement SET title = #{title}, raw_text = #{rawText}, acceptance_text = #{acceptanceText}, clarification_text = #{clarificationText}, status = #{status}, initiative_id = #{initiativeId}, version_id = #{versionId}, pool_status = #{poolStatus}, source = #{source}, review_comment = #{reviewComment}, reviewed_by = #{reviewedBy}, reviewed_at = #{reviewedAt}, clarification_questions = #{clarificationQuestions}, assumptions = #{assumptions}, task_drafts = #{taskDrafts}, planned_at = #{plannedAt}, clarified_at = #{clarifiedAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE requirement SET deleted = 1, deleted_at = #{deletedAt}, deleted_by = #{deletedBy}, updated_at = #{deletedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE requirement SET deleted = 0, deleted_at = NULL, deleted_by = NULL, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 1
